title: No phase checkpoint mechanism: run state unrecoverable after mid-run context compaction
description: spec and run skills regularly hit context compaction mid-run in MCP mode. When compaction occurs the agent has no reliable record of which phases completed and what they produced: the run file is written only at Metrics Recording (late in the skill), so earlier phase completions are invisible on resume. The agent must re-derive current state from the compacted conversation summary, which is unreliable and observed to cause phase repetition, missed tasks, and incorrect status assumptions. A related gap exists for reasoning capture: push_thinking_blocks accumulates blocks in session-persistent RunState correctly but the skill calls it only once at Phase 5a/7a. If compaction fires before that point the agent synthesises thinking blocks from an impoverished view of the run, as implementation-phase reasoning is no longer in context. Note: a1000105-0612-4000-8000-000000000105 covers the retrieval gap (no read_thinking_blocks tool and no disk persistence); this signal covers the complementary prevention gap (no incremental capture before compaction risk accumulates).
proposed_resolution: Implement a checkpoint_phase MCP tool accepting { run_id, phase_id, summary } that appends { phase_id, summary, timestamp } to a phase_log array written to .moeb/runs/<run_id>.phases.json. Each canonical skill phase ends with a one-line checkpoint_phase call before transitioning. On resume after compaction the agent reads the phases file to know exactly what completed and what is on disk, enabling coherent continuation without re-deriving state from a degraded summary. Separately, update all canonical skills to call push_thinking_blocks at the end of each major phase boundary (Plan, Implement, Verify at minimum) rather than only at Phase 5a/7a, so that implementation reasoning is captured incrementally before compaction risk accumulates. The two changes are independent and can be delivered in either order.
